description: This PHP class 'LDAPAuthProvider' implements an LDAP authentication provider for the OrangeHRM system. It handles LDAP-based user authentication, interaction with LDAP services, and integrates with the system's credential and user management workflows.

classes.name: LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: A class that implements LDAP-based authentication for OrangeHRM, managing LDAP connections, user synchronization, and authentication flow.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of LDAPService.

methods.name: getLDAPSyncService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of LDAPSyncService.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of AuthenticationService.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs LDAP-based user authentication by verifying credentials against LDAP, managing user data, and handling exceptions.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority level of this authentication provider, here set to 5000.
